hints.title: Cyclic Grouping
hints.text: Every valid string is formed by repeating the three-character pattern abc.

hints.title: Counting Periods
hints.text: A new abc period must begin whenever the current character is not strictly greater than the previous character.

hints.title: Total Insertions Formula
hints.text: If k cycles are required, the total length of the completed string is 3 * k. The insertions required is 3 * k minus word length.

hints.title: Period Counting Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass counting character inversions to determine cycle count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating insertion character-by-character is unnecessary and complex.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that non-increasing characters imply a new abc group.
